title: Spectral Analysis of the $D_{\log}^{(λ, N)}$ Operators
summary: This paper investigates the recent Connes-Consani-Moscovici $D_{\log}^{(λ, N)}$ operators, whose spectra are currently hypothesized to approach the zeros of $ζ\left(\frac{1}{2} +is\right)$ as $λ, N \rightarrow \infty$. It turns out that when considering different standard notions of error, the dissonance between the spectra and Riemann $ζ$ zeros either appears to or can be proven to be inverse logarithmic in nature, which elegantly fits the distribution of prime numbers.
